_comment: What each utility's own interconnection application asks for (review-audit draft 03), as cited DATA: loaded by backend/src/utilityRequirements.ts and read by the reviewer gate for the job's utility. Rows land SEEDED. A missing item is a warning unless the row quotes the utility's own page verbatim with a named source and the quote names the item (Helm's #637 bar); only then may whenMissing 'blocker' block. Records match the job's state and utility name (any of matchNames, as whole words, after lower-casing and '&' -> 'and'). A person's verified items or an official read on the utility's filing row (utility_filing_lookups.application_requirements_json) override these per key. To add a utility, add a record here: no code. Quotes were read from the page bytes on fetchedAt.
